# QR dependencies

Vendored unchanged for offline availability; loaded only when the QR window/scanner is used.

- `qrcode-1.4.4.js`: qrcode-generator 1.4.4, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT. Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator. Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js
- `jsqr-1.4.0.js`: jsQR 1.4.0, Apache-2.0 (see jsqr-LICENSE). Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR. Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js

QR decoding is local. Camera frames and selected pictures are not uploaded.
